title: The 2005 Nobel citation: Helicobacter pylori in gastritis and peptic ulcer
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Barry Marshall and J. Robin Warren with discovering the bacterium and its role in gastritis and peptic ulcer disease.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 2005 says Barry J. Marshall and J. Robin Warren received the prize in physiology or medicine for their discovery of the bacterium Helicobacter pylori and its role in gastritis and peptic ulcer disease. The record dates the award 3 October 2005. The card is that citation.
